goal: Allow users and external applications to manually protect blocks from pruning on pruned nodes
Prevents unloaded wallets and indexers from losing blocks required for rescans
agreement: Strong support with all earlier technical objections resolved
Supports enabling wallets to run on pruned nodes without losing rescan data (achow101, stickies-v)
Verified by testing an electrs indexer on a pruned signet node (optout21)

categories.name: rpc
why: P2 because external applications need a way to protect blocks on pruned nodes from being deleted
Enables tools like indexers and wallets to safely operate without risking full resyncs
